events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the shooting of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a voice that shaped a generation and continues to resonate today. Which of his tracks still hits hardest for you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: 84 years young, the spirit of Jimi Hendrix lives on. His guitar work continues to inspire – what's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles walked across that zebra crossing and gave us 'Abbey Road'. Still sounds as fresh today, doesn't it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and solo star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54! Happy birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune featuring that unmistakable voice?

events.title: 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the iconic 007 film franchise.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy.

events.title: 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track is your hidden gem from the double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track?
